# EIRT7: EXTENDED LIFE PRODUCT

**Pillar:** Environmental Criteria  
**Points:** 1  
**Mandatory for Certification:** No  
**Project types:** Print, Digital, Hybrid, Packaging, Signage, Exhibit, Website, App  
**Related SDGs:** SDG 9, SDG 11, SDG 12

## Description
When a longer lifetime is desirable for a product or system, it is designed to be reused, recharged, repaired, and/or upgraded as an environmental benefit.

## Why it matters
Product design for longer life than the industry average.
